verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers ClickUp's API, AI agents, and general product features, but contains no documentation or community confirmation of real-time/live sync of teammates' changes across open sessions without refresh (e.g., live cursors, real-time task updates). The one mention of 'real-time chat' (clickup-comm-3) refers only to chat messaging, not general workspace/task live updates. This is a fair collaboration axis for a project-management SaaS, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
